color.note: Graphite chrome, warm paper map. Chrome hues are reserved: accent = the player's hand, warn and critical = deviation. Everything nominal is grey.

tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: The desk: app background, the top resource bar, the viewport around the map.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Panel body. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised inside a panel: panel headers, colonist cards, digest tiles.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Controls at rest (buttons, inputs, meter tracks) and row hover inside panels.

tokens.name: bg-400
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed controls. Only ink and ink-muted text sit on it.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, row dividers, the top bar's cell rules. Decorative: never the only thing that separates two states.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Control borders and state-tag outlines; at least 3:1 on bg-000 through bg-300.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and live values, on every bg and every -soft fill (8.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meter labels, jobs, the verbs in the log. On bg-000 to bg-400 and every -soft fill (5.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: section labels, timestamps, units. On bg-000 to bg-300 and every -soft fill (4.7:1 or more); never on bg-400.

tokens.name: meter-track
tokens.usage: The empty part of a need or stock bar.

tokens.name: meter-fill
tokens.usage: A bar's fill while its value is inside the nominal band. Grey on purpose: a healthy colony is a grey colony. 4.3:1 on meter-track.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The player's hand: selection, focus, the active tab, pinned panels, player handles in the log, a running automation. As text, on bg-000 to bg-400 and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a selected row or an active toggle; text on it is ink or accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Drifting out of band: act within the shift. Always paired with the triangle glyph and a word. As text, on bg-000 to bg-400 and warn-soft. Lighter than critical (1.9:1) so the two separate without hue.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warn row or tag; text on it is ink or warn.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Marks and text on a warn fill (the triangle's exclamation).

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Act now: starvation, collapse, fire. Always paired with the diamond glyph and a word. As text, on bg-000 to bg-200 and critical-soft only.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a critical alert row; text on it is ink, ink-muted or critical.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Marks and text on a critical fill (the diamond's exclamation, a critical button).

tokens.name: map-ground
tokens.usage: Open ground on the current z-level: the paper the colony is drawn on.

tokens.name: map-ground-deep
tokens.usage: Ground one z-level down seen through open tiles, and unrevealed ground.

tokens.name: map-grid
tokens.usage: Tile dots on map-ground. Decorative; fades out below 75% zoom.

tokens.name: map-ink
tokens.usage: Everything written or drawn on the map: label text, region outlines, token rims, casing under accent selection. 5.5:1 on map-ground, 14.6:1 on map-paper.

tokens.name: map-paper
tokens.usage: Label plates, colonist tokens, alert pins and the casing under map-plan lines; labels on the dark zones (forest, mine, sleep, dining, rec).

tokens.name: map-plan
tokens.usage: Designated but not yet built: dashed outline and hatch, always cased in map-paper. 4:1 on map-ground.

tokens.name: zone-farm
tokens.usage: Farming zones. Pattern: horizontal furrows. Label in map-ink (8.5:1).

tokens.name: zone-forest
tokens.usage: Forestry zones. Pattern: stipple. Label in map-paper (5.4:1).

tokens.name: zone-mine
tokens.usage: Mining zones. Pattern: cross-hatch. Label in map-paper (4.6:1).

tokens.name: zone-storage
tokens.usage: Storage zones. Pattern: crate grid. Label in map-ink (11.9:1).

tokens.name: zone-sleep
tokens.usage: Sleeping quarters. Pattern: none (solid). Label in map-paper (7.2:1).

tokens.name: zone-dining
tokens.usage: Dining halls. Pattern: diagonal hatch. Label in map-paper (4.9:1).

tokens.name: zone-rec
tokens.usage: Recreation. Pattern: vertical rule. Label in map-paper (5.6:1).

families.cond: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Plex Sans for anything read as a sentence or a name.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Digest and dialog titles; panel titles use body-strong.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Panel titles, colonist names, alert titles.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines, alert details, meter labels.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Plex Sans Condensed for labels that must fit: set section, tag and plate in uppercase.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the digest headline, a colony name.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section labels inside panels and resource names in the top bar, uppercase, in ink-subtle.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Colonist state tags and map label plates, uppercase.

groups.name: Readouts
groups.note: Plex Mono for every number that updates, so digits never jitter.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Resource values in the top bar.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Meter values, rates, counts in panels.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: Timestamps and durations in the activity log and alerts, in ink-subtle.

spacing.note: 4px base. Panels pad space-3; rows gap space-2.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to label; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between columns in a row; between meters.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding; between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between docked panels; around the map viewport.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of the away digest.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Margins of full-screen views (digest, settings).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons in panel headers; compact roster rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, inputs, alert and log rows at minimum.

tokens.name: panel-header
tokens.usage: Panel header and the workspace tab bar.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: The resource bar along the top edge.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: One map tile at 100% zoom; zoom steps are whole multiples up to 400%.

tokens.name: panel-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest a docked panel may get.

radius.note: Machined, not soft. Map tiles are always square.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Map tiles and zone regions, the top bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, meter tracks, label plates.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and cards.

shadow.note: Docked panels have no shadow; separation is hairlines. Only floating things cast one.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Undocked panels, menus, tooltips: anything floating over the map.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and gamepad focus: a 1px desk gap, then 2px of solid accent (5.3:1 or more on every bg).
